title: Verify each known-DDR4 DIMM page with fresh data and propagate failures through the complete caller path
limits: Fresh data and exclusive stable ownership are required. No new remote token acquisition or controller reset is attempted. Identical EEPROM pages are rejected. Pending transactions/invalid nonlocal frames/unresponsive peers use the existing intentional terminal halt; safe ordinary initialization failures propagate EFI_DEVICE_ERROR. The SSA wrapper returns its observed existing nonzero rejection4 with caller buffer unchanged; arbitrary external diagnostic consumers are outside the ROM proof. No established relation to the physical intermittent60/67 trigger. Failure/reset continuation requires a sole active BSP and no prior initialized remote workers; uncertain worker state takes the existing terminal halt before callbacks.
